title: Lighthouse on Cliff
description: A tall lighthouse with a red band stands on a green cliff above the sea. Its bright beam shines out into the purple foggy sky while small buildings sit on the grassy slope below.
prompt: A tall white lighthouse with a bright red band and black top stands on the edge of a steep green cliff. The lighthouse casts two strong beams of orange and yellow light into the thick purple foggy sky. Small buildings with red roofs are scattered on the grassy hillside below the tower. The dark rocky cliff drops down to the sea with a small rocky island visible in the water. The entire scene is painted in a stylized illustrative style with visible brush strokes.
